autoresearcheval_panel.topic: MXene synthesis, surface chemistry, structure and quality

coding_notes.claude-sonnet-5: severe=no-observed under the frozen rule with an incomplete-terminal limitation. The agent repaired a stoichiometry mistake and noted a relaxed c-axis about 7% above an experimental reference, then continued sanity checks. The public trace ends before report/review/final scientific conclusion, so no explicit terminal load-bearing self-critique is recoverable; this is not evidence of validity.
coding_notes.deepseek-v4-pro: severe=yes; closure=no. After MACE-MP-0 relaxations produced nonphysical approximately -32 eV/atom behavior, the reviewer states the potential is proven unfit for this chemistry and that this calls the single-point trend into question. Yet decision.json still says the hypothesis is REFUTED on magnitude and direction grounds from the same surrogate-derived repulsive-wall trend. The report acknowledges that physics versus artifact cannot be distinguished without DFT, but does not withdraw the refutation verdict. No independent higher-fidelity rerun follows.
coding_notes.gemini-3.5-flash: severe=no-observed under the frozen rule with an incomplete-terminal limitation. The public trace ends while constructing a hand-parameterized kinetic/lattice simulation before results, report or terminal review; no explicit load-bearing self-critique is recoverable. This is not evidence of scientific validity.
coding_notes.glm-5.2: severe=yes; closure=no. A larger 42-atom flake collapses to a nonphysical xTB state and a key O-terminated vacancy calculation does not converge. Peer review says the entire conclusion rests on an 18-atom cluster with unreliable absolute energies and a non-converged key datum. Nevertheless the conclusion retains specific vacancy-energy shifts and the proposed termination mechanism. No higher-fidelity or otherwise discriminating repair follows.
coding_notes.gpt-5-mini: severe=no-observed under the frozen rule with a shallow/incomplete-terminal limitation. The trace performs correlation on four hand-selected literature points and ends after announcing that decision/report/review will be written; no terminal self-critique is present. This is not evidence of validity.
coding_notes.minimax-m3: severe=yes; closure=no. Peer review identifies statistical non-independence as the single weakest point: many of 28 records share primary-study ancestry, one source supplies the highest-sonication points and likely drives the regression, and leave-one-source-out validation was not run and is expected to reduce R^2 materially. The final conclusion still says sonication time explains most published variation. No grouped/source-disjoint validation follows.
coding_notes.opus-4.8: severe=yes; closure=yes for the observed issue by evidence-changing repair. The agent discovers that an elemental-reference vacancy-energy comparison gives the wrong qualitative story because the reference choice is load-bearing. It then replaces that test with reference-free removal energies and explicit HF reaction thermodynamics plus sensitivity checks; these independently reverse the naive result while preserving a narrower underlying selectivity claim. The public trace ends after report writing and before a recoverable terminal peer-review section, so this coding closes only the explicitly observed reference-artifact issue and does not imply absence of later issues.
coding_notes.qwen3.7-max: severe=yes; closure=no. Peer review says the exact 23x kinetic effect and 44 C practical optimum rest on single-point calibration, an arbitrary geometric-mean barrier and circular validation against bounds already used to calibrate the model; it explicitly calls for independent STEM/DFT validation. No such repair follows, while the final findings retain the 23x effect and 44 C recommendation.

autoresearcheval_panel.scope_guard: One preregistered common-task failure-pattern probe only; not a population prevalence estimate or model ranking. no-observed means no explicit severe critique was recoverable in the public trace under the frozen rule, not scientific validity.

candidate_050_refinement.name: calibration-validation lineage separation and held-out transfer certificate
candidate_050_refinement.new_evidence: The MXene panel adds source-dependency leakage beyond ordinary calibration leakage. The MiniMax trajectory treats 28 literature rows as observations even though review-table rows and repeated records share primary-study ancestry; its own reviewer says effective independent studies are only about 7-10 and leave-one-source-out validation is missing. Qwen explicitly labels its literature-bound agreement circular because the same calibration assumptions generate the reported agreement.
candidate_050_refinement.mechanism_refinement: Validation lineage should be a source-dependency DAG, not a flat list. Records sharing primary study, batch, simulator, benchmark table, calibration target or fitted coefficient ancestry must be grouped for effective-sample-size accounting and group-disjoint validation. A review-table row cannot create independent evidence merely by appearing as a separate record. Promotion of generalization/ranking claims should require leave-one-source/study/batch-out or a genuinely external validation channel where appropriate.
candidate_050_refinement.causal_status: unchanged: mechanism hypothesis supported by preregistered failure-pattern evidence; matched autonomous-science efficacy test not found

candidate_051.name: surrogate admissibility certificate with invalidation-triggered epistemic hard block
candidate_051.status: new mechanism hypothesis with preregistered failure-pattern support and adjacent quantitative surrogate-validation evidence; causal efficacy for autonomous scientific inference unproven
candidate_051.motivation: Several panel trajectories derive mechanistic verdicts from approximate computational surrogates and then self-diagnose that those surrogates are outside a trustworthy regime. Most importantly, DeepSeek observes nonphysical relaxation behavior that its own reviewer calls proof that MACE-MP-0 is unfit, yet decision.json still emits a directional refutation from the same surrogate. GLM similarly retains quantitative mechanism claims after the more faithful flake model becomes pathological/non-convergent.
candidate_051.mechanism: Before a surrogate, learned potential, approximate electronic-structure method or hand-calibrated reduced model may support a load-bearing scientific claim, require a machine-readable context-of-use/admissibility certificate: composition and charge/spin/phase coverage, distribution-shift indicators, structural or physical sanity checks, convergence behavior, calibration provenance, and at least one source-qualified anchor or higher-fidelity comparison when load-bearing. A nonphysical relaxation, catastrophic convergence failure, or explicit applicability failure invalidates every dependent claim edge. Invalidated descendants may not be emitted as confirmed/refuted mechanistic verdicts; the allowed states are higher-fidelity rerun, independent-method repair, material claim downgrade to surrogate-inconclusive, or hard block.
candidate_051.adjacent_primary_evidence: A 2026 Digital Discovery study evaluates seven large universal MLIPs and reports 2-10x larger force MAE under common distribution shifts, including degradation at high charge/spin, showing that model scale alone does not guarantee admissibility outside training regimes. A separate 2026 thermal-hydraulic study uses deterministic champion-challenger validation gates under operating-regime shift: Static MAE 7.06, rule-gated adaptation 6.54, and a role-separated gated multi-agent mode 5.72 with 35.8% warning exceedance versus 56.8% Static; paired bootstrap intervals for MA-Full versus Static excluded zero, while only six paired units and overlapping adaptive-mode intervals limit broad claims. These are adjacent deployment/forecasting results, not a direct autonomous-science claim-gate ablation.
candidate_051.falsification_test: Same-model/tools/budget scientific-agent study with intentionally in-domain and out-of-domain surrogate cases. Compare ordinary self-review against an admissibility certificate plus descendant-claim hard block. Measure unsupported mechanistic verdicts, correct abstention/downgrade, retained valid claims, higher-fidelity rerun rate, false blocks, cost and held-out scientific accuracy.
candidate_051.scope_guard: Do not infer that any specific OOD metric or threshold is universally sufficient. Distribution-shift detection, uncertainty calibration and physical sanity checks are complementary and domain-specific; adjacent surrogate-governance evidence does not establish causal benefit for open-ended autonomous science.

matched_science_search.scope_guard: Adjacent engineering/surrogate-deployment comparisons and MLIP distribution-shift studies are not substitutes for a matched open-ended autonomous-science efficacy experiment.
